mainline_reference_decode.warning: This is a Linux mainline reference classification only, not an RG34XX OPP approval.

report.warning: Do not use the pinned vendor cpufreq raw-value switch as an OPP approval: its consumer casts the NVMEM result to u32* even though the DTS cell is 2 bytes and the pinned NVMEM core allocates exactly cell->bytes. Silicon-revision semantics also remain unverified.

The field layout mirrors the pinned sunxi-thermal-ng source for sun50iw9p1. Raw fields do not prove that AVCC/thermal calibration was accepted, that live temperatures are valid, or that closed-loop DVFS is safe.

generic_soc_identity.note: These are generic SoC bus sysfs strings only. They are not substituted for the vendor sunxi_get_soc_ver() result and do not certify a speed bin or authorize any OPP.

limitations: This report decodes only the two bounded NVMEM cells captured by the read-only inventory collector.
The speed-bin value is raw evidence only. No OPP mask is inferred and no operating point is approved.
The thermal calibration fields are diagnostic only and do not certify a calibrated sensor or temperature limit.
No CPU clock, PMIC, regulator, PLL or thermal control register was read or written by this parser.
